rule: A contract changes only by a new version. The spec, every implementer and the tests change in the same commit, and the change is recorded in decisions.jsonl. tests/run_tests.py checks that every file below carries the current marker.

contracts.what: Normalized conversation JSON and message ids (T3u, T3a, T3a2), and the same ids in Markdown markers.
tests: schema: renderer tags the version and gives every message a unique mid
schema: an unknown version is refused by seed, SSD and telemetry

contracts.what: The handoff file: front matter, sections, states, log line, and the folder's .ledger.json owner setting.
tests: ledger: prepared -> sent -> acknowledged -> completed, then check
ledger: a handoff from a newer contract version is refused

contracts.what: Marking relayed and pasted material: a FROM: first line, FROM: ... END FROM blocks, and >""" pastes.
tests: ssd: a FROM ... END FROM block after your words is stripped from own text
seed: a FROM block inside your message is flagged as a paste, speaker stays you

contracts.what: chat-relay's reply statuses: done (explicit completion signal), unconfirmed (text stopped, no signal), pending.
tests: relay: text that stops changing without a signal is never "done"
